description: This file defines a configuration structure for a relay gateway, along with static utility methods to load, save, and clear configuration and event data using UserDefaults. It involves encoding and decoding configuration data, managing relay settings, and storing event messages with timestamps.

classes.name: ShareGatewayRelayConfig
classes.description: A codable, sendable, equatable struct that holds configuration data for the relay gateway, including URL, token, password, session key, and optional delivery options.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from UserDefaults, decoding it from JSON if available.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Encodes and saves the relay configuration to UserDefaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Saves a log message with a timestamp into UserDefaults under the last event key.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from UserDefaults, returning nil if none exists or if the string is empty.
